query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website**.

## How to Download Python

1. **Visit the official website**: Go to **https://www.python.org/downloads/**
2. **Select your version**: The website will automatically detect your operating system and display a prominent download button for the latest stable release (e.g., Python 3.13.1 or newer)
3. **Download the installer**: Click the download button to get the installer file for your OS (Windows, macOS, or Linux)

## Alternative Options

- **Windows users**: You can also install Python from the **Microsoft Store** for convenient automatic updates, though the official website version offers more customization
- **macOS users**: You can use **Homebrew** by running `brew install python` in Terminal
- **Linux users**: Most distributions include Python in their package manager (e.g., `sudo apt install python3` for Ubuntu/Debian)

## Important Tips

- Always **check "Add Python to PATH"** during Windows installation
- **Python 2.x is no longer supported** — only download Python 3.x versions
- For the most up-to-date release, visit the official release page at **https://www.python.org/downloads/release/**
